evidence.decision: Chooses keyboard plus semantic content type and separates app-only input views from genuine systemwide keyboard extensions.
evidence.artifact: Requires configuration/layout implementation or a field-to-keyboard/content/submit/visibility specification.
evidence.transformation: Parcel tracking example replaces an incompatible phone pad and obscured Track action with suitable semantics and clearance for both field and action.
evidence.verification: Checks required characters, correction, movement, hardware alternatives and relevant extension switching; fails impossible entry or hidden completion.
evidence.applicability: Preserves secure/phone extension exclusions, system keys/sounds, TV layouts, movable visionOS keyboard and watch nonconfigurable keyboard type.
evidence.handoffs: Loads text-fields, digit-entry-views or entering-data according to the affected entry task rather than invoking all input topics.
evidence.distinctiveness: Semantic keyboard selection, extension scope and simultaneous field/action clearance form a specific operational keyboard workflow.
